title: Guardian: staged commit orchestration for Optimize recommendations
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Implement a 'Guardian' orchestration layer that performs staged commits of Optimize recommendations (batching / caching / quantization configs). The goal is to enable low-risk automated adoption by combining policy-driven gating, traffic canaries, operator approval hooks, and automatic safe rollback triggers. Guardian must integrate with the existing suggestion engine, Console rollout UI, and runtime canary simulation endpoints. Deliverables: orchestration service, policy DSL for gates, canary runner that replays sampled traffic against candidate configs, and an operator workflow in Console for approvals and emergency stop.
acceptance_criteria: Guardian creates deploy plans from Optimize suggestions and persists them in the rollout store
Support for at least three gate types: telemetry thresholds, simulated-canary pass/fail, and manual operator approval
Canary runner can replay sampled live traffic with KV cache enabled and report latency/cost/quality deltas within 5% accuracy of production metrics
Automatic rollback triggers when cost or latency regressions exceed configured thresholds
Console shows per-rollout timeline, current stage, and one-click abort/rollback
E2E integration tests for happy path and failure modes included in CI
notes: Design trade-offs considered: (1) central orchestration service vs. distributed per-customer coordinator — chose central for easier auditing and uniform policy enforcement; (2) optimistic immediate apply with short canary vs. staged ramp — chose staged ramp to prioritize reliability for high-throughput tenants
Guardrails: immutable audit trail for each decision, timeboxed canary stages, and simulated-canary step that runs in a sandboxed cluster
Policy DSL sketch: allow rules for max-latency-pct, max-cost-pct, min-quality-score, and operator-whitelist tags

Runtime integration points: suggestion service emits candidate config, Guardian stores rollout object, canary runner attaches to sample mirror stream, runtime exposes metrics endpoint under /canary-metrics
